Harness run_repair_tests sets repair_success=True unconditionally, run_contamination_tests checks status 200 only, never imports or calls _matches. No per-request hash logged. Therefore verification discrimination AUROC 1.0 and contamination 0.0 are asserted not measured. Recomputed: not measurable from evidence.
